title: Daily Temperatures
prompt: Given an array of integers temperatures represents the daily temperatures, return an array answer such that answer[i] is the number of days you have to wait after the ith day to get a warmer temperature. If there is no future day for which this is possible, keep answer[i] == 0 instead.
hints: Monotonic stack: store indices of temperatures in decreasing order. When we see a warmer day, it resolves previous colder days.
For each day, pop from stack while current temp > stack top's temp. The answer for stack top is (current index - stack top index).
Push current index onto stack after resolving. Stack stores indices of days waiting for a warmer day.
O(n) - each index pushed and popped at most once.
